text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista has moved up to the Senior Year.
We had planned to go to Hatsumode together to pray for another successful year.
—...Or so it seemed, however.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're both back already?
Weren't you going for Hatsumode?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Isn't that girl Buena Vista!?
Wah, it's really her!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Buena-chan...!?
Waaah, so cute!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hello!
Happy New Ye—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
"Look, it's Buena Vista!" "Where, where!?"
"I saw your race!" "Please take a picture!"
"Oh my gosh!" "Buena-chaaan!!!!"

—She was swarmed by fans in no time flat,
so she returned to avoid causing a commotion.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
That must've been rough.
Buena is super popular right now, after all...

Yes, Buena Vista right now...
had gained popularity beyond the world of Umamusume,
truly worthy of being called the "heroine of an era."

text_block_list.name: Talk Show Host
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the midday news.
Our first topic is... this!

text_block_list.name: Talk Show Host
text_block_list.text:
"Taking the internet by storm!
Who is this highly anticipated 'always giving her all' Umamusume?"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
We've arrived at the well-known Umamusume academy,
commonly known as Tracen Academy!
Today, the one I'd like to introduce is... Ah, there she is!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Buena Vista-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Um...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the midday news, "Midday Talks"!
Nice to meet you all, I'm Buena Vista!
It's great to be with you today!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Here we have Buena Vista-san!
Her popularity exploded after the Arima Kinen,
one of Japan's premier Umamusume races, making her the talk of the town!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
You completely took over the trending topics on Umatter for a while!
Tru-ly! The "heroine of our time"!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Our program will explore the daily lives of these spotlighted Umamusume from its own unique angle♪

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—That show was so fun!
Seeing you on TV too, <username>-kun.
choice_data_list: I did turn it down at first, but Buena insisted...

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—That show was so fun!
Seeing you on TV too, <username>-chan.
choice_data_list: I did turn it down at first, but Buena insisted...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If you want to delve into my daily life,
Trainer, you're an essential part of it, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Besides... having you here is reassuring.
I never imagined the day would come
when I'd be chatting on a variety show...

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You're treated like a celebrity, aren't you?
I have an auto-record set for your name, but lately I can't keep up with watching everything.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, are you going to be okay?
Racing is what you're truly here for, so
you don't have to force yourself to do media appearances..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm fine! In fact, getting to try something new is actually fun.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's proof that everyone is calling for me.
I want to answer their expectations as best as I can!
choice_data_list: (The fact that she genuinely means this is just amazing...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Above all, Trainer is coming along too.
Hehe, reassuring, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's true, but...
<username>, you have your own job as a Trainer to do, after all...
choice_data_list: My job is to support whatever Buena wants to do.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's true, but...
<username>, you have your own job as a Trainer to do, after all...
choice_data_list: My job is to support whatever Buena wants to do.

text_block_list.text:
In fact, some Trainers double as managers for their trainees.
I'm not sure if I can go that far myself, though...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Alright, alright, guess that was worry for nothing.
Come on, we're going for Hatsumode, right?
I'm sure a shrine nearby won't be crowded.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —You're right, there's no one here...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... we used to play hide-and-seek
here a lot because nobody ever came around."
choice_data_list: ...No, didn't you end up not doing it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Really?
Though, now that you mention it, the memory...
choice_data_list: Because you got scared and dashed out right away—
Because you got scared and dashed right out—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
!
C-Can we stop talking about this now!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's pray!
Over here, over here!

Standing shoulder to shoulder with Buena Vista,
I quietly clasp my hands together.
What we pray for is—
choice_data_list: I hope Buena gets plenty of sleep.
I hope Buena can grow even stronger.
I hope Buena gets to have all kinds of experiences.

text_block_list.text:
She will only get busier and busier from here on.
When that happens, what matters most is... sleep.
I prayed she would be able to get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, Trainer...
Such a serious look...)

Even tougher battles await Buena Vista in the future.
I prayed that she would shine with all her might when the time comes.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, Trainer...
Such a serious look...)
Starting with media appearances, all kinds of experiences surely awaited her ahead. I prayed that they would all serve to nurture her growth.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, Trainer...
Such a serious look...)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(They're probably thinking about me, aren't they?
Then I should—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(May you stay healthy this year as well.
May we find a breathtaking view meant only for us.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(I don't know what kind of view awaits us yet...
but I pray I can reach it together with you—!)

On the way back to the academy after safely finishing the New Year's shrine visit...
Just to be safe, while walking away from the crowds—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
—Nakayama-sa~n!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Hey, what're you doing here...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Did we get lost again?
And with Trainer right here, too...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That little lady of yours wanders off in a heartbeat.
You'd better hold her hand tight, got it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's all right!
There are tons of kind people in the world, just like you, Nakayama-san!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm not lost today!
Um... a lot happened, you see.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"A lot, huh...?
...Yeah."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Noon Talks"... was it?
Tough being popular, huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You watched it?
I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"If you ever get the chance, I'd love for you to
make an appearance too, Nakayama-san!
The staff are all such wonderful people!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Unlike you who's made a name for yourself,
I'm just an Umamusume who took 12th in the Kikuka Sho.
There's no way in hell they'd call on me."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, if I eat you...
I suppose that wouldn't apply.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Walk the royal road in the Senior Class too, got it?
...Do it for my sake as well.
—Well then, Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Will I get eaten up?
In one big gulp...
choice_data_list: Then just eat them right back!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that sounds good!
Let's take a bite and give it our best this year too!
